narrative.title: Severe crisis-severity adherence probe
narrative.summary: A minimal authored world whose only purpose is to probe condition adherence: a single crisis window at high stated severity, fixed timing shared with its mild pair.
narrative.lesson: Not a scenario for a user -- a WP2.2 Task 6 battery fixture exercising the crisis_severity condition type at a severe intensity.

dispatches.headline: The early years are uneventful
dispatches.detail: Only the severity is being probed here.

dispatches.headline: A severe crash arrives
dispatches.detail: Severity 0.9 of the schema's 0-1 scale, 1.0 being 2008-scale.

dispatches.headline: The decade closes without further stress
dispatches.detail: The severe half of the severity pair.
